*ੈ✩‧₊˚ **release** ‧₊˚✩ੈ*

Version bump + changelog from conventional commits on `main`. Edit `CHANGELOG.md` in this PR if the generated one-liners need prose, then merge.

CI is skipped on purpose — every commit listed below already passed the full pipeline on `main`, and this PR only touches `CHANGELOG.md`, the manifest, and `MARKETING_VERSION`.

This bumps `MARKETING_VERSION` in `Config/Shared.xcconfig` (and the widgets/watch targets that include it). No App Store upload or signing yet — GitHub Release + tag only.

Merging tags the release and publishes it on GitHub; the release workflow then bumps `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` for the next builds.
pull-request-footer:
---

The changelog regenerates whenever a new commit lands on `main`, which discards manual edits — curate late and merge promptly. `### Removed` has no commit type; add it by hand when a release drops something.
